guidance_phase_label_normalization.basis: participant clarified the task was completed without guidance

arithmetic_checks.net_wpm_formula: (630 characters / 5 characters per word) / (180 seconds / 60 seconds per minute)
arithmetic_checks.double_click_components: 4 gestures * 2 clicks = 8 clicks, already included in 112
arithmetic_checks.conditional_character_balance: 672 - 42 = 630 only if each printable key adds one character and each deletion removes one; no event log establishes this assumption.

scope_and_limitations: Participant confirms actual measurements from a task completed entirely by a human, without guidance. These are participant-supplied aggregates, not independently verified input or resource traces.

No raw input-event, application-resource, or process-event logs, measurement run ID, measurement date, actual hardware specification, or capture software definitions were supplied for this aggregate record. The package date is not a measurement date.
The original Guidance / waiting phase label is normalized to Waiting / idle following the participant clarification that the task was unassisted; its 90-second value is unchanged.
This 720-second aggregate record is reported separately from the retained 734.5256836999979-second guided-practice log. It does not replace, relabel, or reconcile that historical record.

Older n=0 or reference-pending labels elsewhere in the preserved archive describe the evidence available before this update. Current reporting includes this participant-confirmed unassisted aggregate baseline, while raw-trace-backed or independently verified unassisted measurement evidence remains unavailable.
The 180-second typing window spans task phases and is not additional elapsed time. Pause duration overlaps the task and is not added to its total; overlap with the typing window was not specified.

Inter-key and hold statistics lack the eligible key set, timestamp source, gap population, and pause-exclusion rule. A single timeline cannot be reconstructed from these summaries, and these values are not directly comparable to agent controller waits.

CPU-seconds are processor time, not elapsed time or utilization percentage. Capture boundaries, process selection, and Chrome child-process inclusion rules were not supplied; these aggregates do not establish exclusive task costs.
MiB means 1048576 bytes. Summed RSS can double-count shared memory. Sampling cadence, mean weighting, and the simultaneous group-peak aggregation method were not supplied.

Mouse travel is in screen-coordinate pixels at an assumed 1920 by 1080 resolution, not an independently confirmed display setup or physical distance. Four double-click gestures comprise eight of the 112 clicks; those eight are not additional clicks.
Process ancestry is participant-confirmed measured data. Raw process-event traces were not supplied, so independent verification is not claimed.

Arithmetic checks validate internal totals only, not measurement provenance, task-output correctness, human indistinguishability, population behavior, an agent-versus-human speed ratio, or an official competition score.
